items.summary: After closing a file with Discard changes, the image resize corner handles and toolbar remain rendered on the start screen.

events.detail: External tester (Telegram, ids 117661-117662): resized an image inside a file, closed the tab via the close button choosing Discard changes — the resize corner handles and the image toolbar stayed on the start screen and persisted when reopening the file. Owner: 'probably already fixed in 2.9, will verify' — verify on the first prerelease build before scoping a repair. Visual evidence (messages 117661/117662, analyzed 2026-11-17): the residue is not limited to the image toolbar — a floating properties/format bar (edit, image, list, alignment, delete actions) plus orphaned gold selection handles remain over the home screen, partially covering the Restore-all button, and the same residue reappears after reopening the file from the tab bar; a stray gold edit badge also floats in the header area. Scope the verification and repair to the full floating-toolbar/selection-overlay teardown on tab close with Discard, not just the image corner handles.

items.summary: Inline HTML inside a ruby annotation block reaches the preview's innerHTML sink unsanitized; the exposure was closed by default only while HTML rendering was disabled.

events.detail: Security read-through of the muya renderers (2026-11-18), filed as issue #282 under the repository owner account xronocode (the PR closes it): htmlRuby fed token.raw straight into htmlToVNode, whose implementation is wrapper.innerHTML = html — an inside ... would execute handlers. Not exploitable in the default configuration (disableHtml: true suppresses non-image inline-HTML tokenization); the hole reopens when HTML rendering is enabled or a crafted ruby token reaches the renderer (paste-driven).

Implemented on PR #283 (merge 11e5f2da): htmlToVNode(sanitize(token.raw, PREVIEW_DOMPURIFY_CONFIG, disableHtml)) keeps ruby/rt/rp while stripping handlers; new pin html-ruby-sanitize 2/2 (onerror payload dropped, ruby markup kept); grace current lint 0 errors.
